profile.description: Everything the export carries. The operator's own instrumented base.

candidates.statement: A Bus is sometimes booked on two jobs whose times overlap. This happened 80 times across 2 of them. Is the overlap allowed, or are these mistakes?

When status is 'Ran', work_type is filled in almost every time (322 of 322). When it is 'Planned', it is almost never filled in (0 of 70). Is work_type required for one and not the other?
work_type is essentially never filled in when status is 'Planned' (0 of 70), though it is filled in elsewhere. Is that case exempt from needing work_type?
